SYNTHETIC EUS REPORT
Date of service: 03/14/2031
Endoscopist: Corvin Ashdale, MD (fictional)

Findings: A linear echoendoscope was advanced to the second portion of the duodenum.
EUS imaging was performed from the esophagus, stomach and duodenum.
A 9 cm pancreatic pseudocyst was seen adjacent to the gastric body.
Under EUS guidance, the pseudocyst was punctured from the gastric body with a 19-gauge needle and 20 mL of fluid was aspirated.
EUS-guided transmural drainage of the pseudocyst was then performed across the posterior gastric wall.
